# Akwaan Cache

This directory contains derived search and asset cache data. The source Skills
now target the Akwaan `World → Scope → ChallengeType → ContentItem` model.

The existing JSON files were produced by the legacy question pipeline and must
be treated as stale until regenerated by the updated orchestrator. Do not use a
cached record when its schema, mechanic compatibility, Scope, answer mode, or
media ownership cannot be proven against the current ContentItem contract.
